item.text: Lamine was modest in his demands.

unmapped.construction: An adjectival predicate with a domain prepositional phrase restricting the property.

issues.text: The location template mentions 'in its demands' as an oblique on an event, but a copular predication has no event symbol for an oblique to attach to, and copular rejects adjectives with complements.
